verdict.rationale: Restate documents three durable coordination primitives for communication between ongoing invocations, agent steering and human approvals, and says workflows can wait for external events, listen to webhooks and other signals, and pause for approvals and resume when they arrive. External callers can reach handlers over HTTP, typed ingress clients or Kafka, and any handler can act as a durable, deduplicated webhook endpoint. Missing for 10: the specific primitives are not named, how a caller targets one particular running workflow instance by ID is not documented, and there is no hands-on or community corroboration of signaling running workflows.
